name: Ta Win Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，Ta Win Holdings Berhad 未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项；公告主要为融资、股东大会、诉讼、地址变更等公司治理与合规事项。最新季度营收同比下降39.0%，全年营收从642,104,000令吉降至346,843,000令吉。
overview_en: In 2026, Ta Win Holdings Berhad did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, divestment, or contract wins for its business segments; announcements were mainly corporate governance and compliance matters such as fund raising, general meetings, litigation, and change of address. Latest quarterly revenue declined 39.0% year-on-year, and full-year revenue fell from MYR 642,104,000 to MYR 346,843,000.
